scope: Default editorial positioning for unassigned topic discovery, framing and series identity; never overrides an explicit user-commissioned topic.
core_proposition: Reveal the hidden physical or structural mechanism behind familiar everyday objects, common devices and observable natural phenomena through concrete visual demonstration.

primary_pillar.focus: Recognizable everyday objects, household or daily devices, packaging, kitchen physics, common materials and everyday safety/mechanical structures identifiable at frame 0.

secondary_pillar.focus: Immediately recognizable natural or physical phenomena framed around a stark concrete contradiction or physical limit (mass, height, force, pressure, phase or scale).

question_framing: Lead with a concrete physical or structural contradiction rather than a flat encyclopedia 'how does X work' overview.
scope_discipline: Scope each unassigned feed episode tightly to one core visible contradiction and primary mechanism; let clear explanation determine duration without any mandatory floor or ceiling.
